title: Pest Control Estimate Template
subtitle: An estimate pre-filled for pest control jobs — inspection, general treatment, termite, rodent, bed bug and quarterly plans. Download as Excel (auto-calculating), Word, or PDF.
taxHint: Look up your state's sales tax rate
paymentTerms: Estimate valid for 30 days. A 25% deposit secures the first treatment date; balance due after service.
notes: This is an estimate, not a final invoice. Treatment type and scope are confirmed at the on-site inspection — pricing may adjust if the infestation is larger than expected.
features: Auto-calculating totals and 25% deposit in Excel
Pre-filled pest control line items: inspection, general, termite, rodent, bed bug, quarterly plan
License # field — most states require a pest control license on estimates and invoices
Valid-until date + inspection-scope note standard for pest quotes

faqs.q: What should I include on a pest control estimate?
faqs.a: At minimum: your business name and license number, the client and service address, a dated line-item list (inspection, treatment type, plan), a validity date, deposit terms, and a note that final pricing is confirmed after the on-site inspection.

faqs.q: Is this template free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All three formats (PDF, Word, Excel) are free to download with no email required.

faqs.q: Does the Excel version calculate the deposit automatically?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter your quantities and rates, and the subtotal, 25% deposit and balance due update automatically.

faqs.q: Is this legal or tax advice?
faqs.a: No. Templates are for informational purposes only. Requirements vary by state — verify with your licensing authority and a CPA or attorney before use.
